newsitem.title: USA: J.P. Morgan unit files $2 bln shelf offer.
newsitem.headline: J.P. Morgan unit files $2 bln shelf offer.

text.p: J.P. Morgan Commercial Mortgage Finance Corp, a unit of J.P. Morgan & Co Inc, filed Friday with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission to register a shelf offering of up to $2 billion in mortgage-pass-through-certificates.
The shelf offering includes previously registered securities.
The certificates will represent an owernship interest in a trust consisting of fixed- and floating rate mortgages.
J.P. Morgan Securities Inc will underwrite the offering, according to the SEC filing.
